tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page, slide and app background. Light-first: white is the default ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, table zebra rows, phone screen grouped sections.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Amethyst-tinted panels: callouts, the selected tab, the 'how it works' band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders, 1px. Decorative only, never the sole separator of controls.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, axis labels and sources on surface and surface-raised (6.2:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Royal violet. Primary buttons, the logo's center facet, key data series, one highlighted number per slide.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow facet of the mark, pressed buttons, dark section-divider slides behind white text.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Light facet of the mark and secondary chart series. Fills only, never text on white.

tokens.name: brand-glow
tokens.usage: Lit tip facet of the mark; in the dark theme, brand-colored text and links on surface (8.3:1).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-colored words, links and inline highlights on surface and surface-tint.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-deep fills (7.4:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: risk-normal
tokens.usage: Normal wound status. Always paired with the word 'Normal' and a check icon; text on surface.

tokens.name: risk-normal-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Normal status pill.

tokens.name: risk-warning
tokens.usage: Warning status (pH 6–7.5 or rising temperature). Always with the word 'Warning' and an alert icon.

tokens.name: risk-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Warning status pill.

tokens.name: risk-infection
tokens.usage: Infection status (pH above 7.5). Always with the word 'Infection' and a shield icon; never color alone.

tokens.name: risk-infection-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the Infection status pill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (3:1+ on all surfaces).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill inner padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label over value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding, gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, phone screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on slides, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap on mobile screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between slide regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Slide margin at 1920×1080 (left/right), hero breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags, chart bars. Amethyst is faceted: keep corners crisp.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Phone sheets, large feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills (Normal, Warning, Infection) and toggles only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating phone mockups and the device frame on slides. Cards on surface use line borders instead.
